statement: For the exact generator-sum Cayley and color-position Schreier adjacency operators at (m,n)=(4,2) defined in source.md and problem.md, the second adjacency eigenvalue of each operator is 2*sqrt(2). Consequently their unnormalized adjacency spectral gaps satisfy psi_{4,2}=beta_{4,2}=4-2*sqrt(2). This statement concerns only the single frozen cell (4,2).
contribution: An exact resolution of the frozen 32-vertex cell: a Fourier decomposition gives sixteen explicit 2-by-2 Cayley blocks and four explicit 2-by-2 Schreier blocks, with exact characteristic polynomials and eigenvalue ordering. The contribution does not claim any other parameter case or bibliographic priority.
